text: {"name":"rf_tx_power_control_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Evaluates a calibrated measurement against a configured target and hysteresis band, then updates the power-control state.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v3":"target_threshold","v5":"adjustment_state","v6":"hysteresis_margin","v7":"calibration_value","v8":"calibrated_measurement","v9":"quantized_measurement"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Target measurement threshold; zero disables this control path."},{"offset":1,"meaning":"Hysteresis margin subtracted from the target threshold."},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Latched power-adjustment state retained within the hysteresis band."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Floating-point calibration value used to transform the input measurement."}]}
